compileClasspath.declaredBy: com.acme.service-conventions plugin, through a platformLibs bucket that extends compileOnly

notes: project(:platform-core) reaches ledger-service through the platformLibs configuration created by the com.acme.service-conventions convention plugin. That configuration extends compileOnly, so platform-core is on compileClasspath but not on runtimeClasspath.
The ledger-service main sources (com.acme.ledger.LedgerApp) import com.acme.platform.money.Money and com.acme.platform.money.MoneyFormatter, which are absent from the runtime classpath.
